| # | Study | The claim | Signal | Tradability |
|--:|---|---|---|---|
| 501 | [Idiosyncratic-Volatility](501-idiosyncratic-volatility/) | Do stocks with high residual (market-beta-removed) volatility really earn lower returns -- the famous IVOL puzzle? | None | Mirage |
| 502 | [Betting-Against-Correlation](502-betting-against-correlation/) | Is the famous "bet against beta" premium really a bet against correlation, not volatility? | Weak | Fragile |
| 503 | [Expected-Idiosyncratic-Skewness](503-expected-idiosyncratic-skewness/) | Do stocks with a fat idiosyncratic right tail (lottery-like upside) really earn lower returns? | None | Mirage |
| 504 | [Coskewness](504-coskewness/) | Do stocks that crash hardest with the market pay you a premium for being bad hedges? | None | Mirage |
| 505 | [Left-Tail-Momentum](505-left-tail-momentum/) | The stocks with the worst recent crash keep underperforming -- does the left tail have momentum? | None | Mirage |
| 506 | [Industry-Momentum](506-industry-momentum/) | Is the famous stock-momentum effect really just winner industries beating loser industries? | None | Mirage |
| 507 | [Cross-Sectional-Momentum](507-cross-sectional-momentum/) | Do past winners keep winning on a small modern large-cap survivor basket? | None | Mirage |
| 508 | [Momentum-Crashes](508-momentum-crashes/) | Momentum prints money until it detonates — does the crash show up on a modern basket, and does vol-scaling repair it? | None | Mirage |
| 509 | [Intermediate-Momentum](509-intermediate-momentum/) | Does momentum really live in the intermediate past (t-12..t-7), not the recent past (t-6..t-1)? | None | Mirage |
| 510 | [Frog-In-The-Pan](510-frog-in-the-pan/) | Is momentum stronger when the past return arrived gradually (in many small steps) than in a few jumps? | None | Mirage |
| 511 | [Volume-Momentum](511-volume-momentum/) | Does trading volume tell you which momentum will keep running and which will reverse first? | None | Mirage |
| 512 | [High-Volume-Return-Premium](512-high-volume-return-premium/) | Do stocks that just traded on unusually high volume keep climbing -- and quiet ones lag? | None | Mirage |
| 513 | [Size-Effect](513-size-effect/) | Do small-cap stocks really out-earn large-caps -- the original Banz (1981) anomaly? | None | Mirage |
| 514 | [Pastor-Stambaugh-Liquidity](514-pastor-stambaugh-liquidity/) | Do stocks whose returns swing harder with aggregate liquidity shocks really pay you more for the privilege? | Weak | Fragile |
| 515 | [Earnings-Announcement-Premium](515-earnings-announcement-premium/) | Do stocks earn a disproportionate share of their return in the few days around their scheduled earnings announcement? | None | Mirage |
| 516 | [Dividend-Month-Premium](516-dividend-month-premium/) | Do stocks really earn more in the months they're predicted to pay a dividend? | Real | Fragile |
| 517 | [Pre-FOMC-Drift](517-pre-fomc-drift/) | Do stocks really drift up in the 24 hours before a scheduled Fed announcement — and does the edge survive being famous? | Real | Fragile |
| 518 | [Time-Series-Momentum](518-time-series-momentum/) | Does an asset's own 12-month trend predict its next month, across equities, bonds, commodities, FX and gold alike? | Weak | Fragile |
| 519 | [Net-Share-Issuance](519-net-share-issuance/) | Do firms that buy back shares beat firms that dilute — on a basket you'd actually hold? | None | Mirage |
| 520 | [External-Financing-Anomaly](520-external-financing-anomaly/) | Should you avoid companies that raise lots of debt and equity? | None | Mirage |
| 521 | [Cash-Based-Operating-Profitability](521-cash-based-operating-profitability/) | Does stripping accruals out of profitability (cash-based operating profit) beat the accrual-laden gross-profitability factor? | Weak | Mirage |
| 522 | [Percent-Operating-Accruals](522-percent-operating-accruals/) | Does scaling operating accruals by earnings (HLVW 2011) sort returns more sharply than scaling by assets (Sloan)? | None | Mirage |
| 523 | [Investment-To-Assets](523-investment-to-assets/) | Do the heaviest capital-spenders underperform the disciplined ones? | None | Mirage |
| 524 | [Operating-Leverage](524-operating-leverage/) | Do firms with a high fixed-cost (operating-leverage) structure earn a premium? | None | Mirage |
| 525 | [R-And-D-Intensity](525-r-and-d-intensity/) | Do firms whose R&D budget is large relative to their market value quietly out-earn the rest? | Weak | Mirage |

| 527 | [Organizational-Capital](527-organizational-capital/) | Do firms with more accumulated organizational capital (from years of SG&A) earn the higher returns the risk story predicts? | None | Mirage |
